title: Clinical outcomes in imported endothelium-in preloaded vs. surgeon-loaded DMEKs in Asian eyes
indication: Fuchs endothelial corneal dystrophy (8 preloaded, 8 surgeon-loaded) or pseudophakic bullous keratopathy including iridocorneal endothelial syndrome and regrafts (12, 32); endothelium-in pull-through DMEK (Endoglide cartridge) by one surgeon at the Singapore National Eye Centre; Asian eyes; prospective, August 2020 to June 2024

groups.description: Imported eye-bank preloaded endothelium-in DMEK grafts (Preloaded DMEK Endoglide, Eversight), processing-to-surgery 72-96 h; first 20 consecutive cases
Surgeon-loaded grafts prepared intra-operatively (SCUBA) and pulled into the Endoglide cartridge; matched 2:1 to the preloaded cases by donor age within 3 years

exclusions.reason: pooled total of the preloaded and surgeon-loaded groups (same eyes)
duplicate donor ECD row whose surgeon-loaded entry differs slightly from tab2 R27C4; Table 2 is cited because it carries the follow-up
p-values and regression odds ratios are not admissible

notes: Preloaded grafts are the technique variant under study (first 20 imported preloaded DMEKs) compared with matched surgeon-loaded controls; recorded as treated and control.
The source of the donor ECD is not stated explicitly; donor tissue was eye-bank supplied (imported), so the reference kind is recorded as donor_eye_bank.
Postoperative central ECD by non-contact specular microscopy (Konan CellChek 20 or Nidek CEM-530); later visits include different subsets of eyes (per-visit n).

series.baseline_label: Pre-operative donor ECD (Table 2 'Donor ECD'); ECL defined relative to it (Methods); tissue supplied by an eye bank
series.notes: Table 2 'Preloaded' column, mean ± SD; per-visit n from the Table 2 footnotes (1, 3 and 6 months)
